question: Does the open-source Lorentzian classifier add causal, after-cost directional edge on SP500 and XAUUSD beyond Euclidean KNN and simple price-only controls?

upstream.implementation_role: Exact original-parity signal variant and shared feature/kernel calculations

variants.official_original: Pinned upstream implementation, including original label alignment and greedy ANN
variants.causal_lorentzian: Exact 8-NN, Lorentzian distance, feature at j labelled by close j to j+4 and eligible only from j+4
variants.causal_euclidean: Identical causal 8-NN and features with Euclidean distance
variants.simple_momentum4: Sign of the prior four-bar return with identical default filters
variants.filter_only_kernel: Kernel slope direction with identical volatility and regime filters, no classifier

candidate_spacing: Causal KNN candidates use historical indices j where j modulo 4 is nonzero, matching the pinned source condition

execution.exit: next H4 Bid open after four signal bars, or next open after an earlier opposite qualified start
execution.overlap: one position at a time; direct opposite flip is allowed at one shared execution open
execution.end_of_sample: open positions without a scheduled executable exit are excluded

promotion_gate: official_original base-cost net bps positive and PF above one on both assets
causal_lorentzian base-cost net bps positive and PF above one on both assets
causal_lorentzian exceeds causal_euclidean and simple_momentum4 net bps on both assets
causal_lorentzian has at least 100 trades per asset
causal_lorentzian is positive in both frozen evaluation blocks on both assets
causal_lorentzian remains positive after removing its five best trades on both assets
causal_lorentzian monthly-bootstrap 95 percent lower bound exceeds zero on both assets
causal_lorentzian remains positive under stress costs on both assets
forbidden: selecting a winning asset, year, direction, or variant as the headline
using labels whose four-bar outcome was unavailable at prediction time
calling upstream parity validation evidence of profitability
placing MT5 orders or pushing a remote
